notes: ~64.7k Tacoma parcels -> PMTiles + H3 hexes. Source: Pierce County GIS Tax Parcels (one-stop geometry + Land_Value/Improvement_Value/Use_Code/Exemption_Code), clipped to the City of Tacoma boundary (see run_tacoma.py; `--live` pulls the service directly). Condo units (stacked per-unit polygons) are merged down onto their $0 'EXR' common-element ground parcel. The H3 ladder prunes r12 (median parcel 603 m²), so parcels start at z12 (parcelMinZoom 12, hartfordmetro/richmond precedent). Parking is OSM-only (undercounts outside well-mapped areas).
